name: pf2e-gm
title_zh: 翻开本地规则库的 PF2e 主持人副驾
tagline_zh: 41,000 条法术、怪物、装备笔记全在 Obsidian 里，跑团时随手查、随手平衡遭遇。
tagline_en: 41,000+ spell, monster, and item notes in your Obsidian vault—look up rules, balance encounters, and keep the.
desc_en: Game mastering and worldbuilding assistant for Pathfinder Second Edition, backed by a local Obsidian vault of the full PF2e rules (41,000+ notes covering spells, feats, creatures, hazards, equipment, deities and rules). Use this whenever the user is preparing or running a Pathfinder 2e game — building or balancing an encounter, looking up a spell, feat, item, monster or rule, statting an NPC, pick
why_zh: 它不靠云端 API，而是直接读你本地的完整规则库，离线也能查；机制上把规则查询和 GM 决策绑在一起。
why_en: It reads your full local ruleset offline, not a cloud API; couples rule lookup with GM decisions, offering balance nudges as you.
limit_zh: 只认 Pathfinder 2e 规则，且必须已有本地 Obsidian 库（41,000+ 笔记）。
limit_en: PF2e only, requires your local Obsidian vault (41k+ notes). No other systems, no story generation—just rules and encounter help.
title_en: A local-rules PF2e GM copilot for prep and play
